boundaries.boundary: ENOENT produces ERR_FNF=1 and file SANITISED_FULL_PATH not found for PEER_IP. Quiet only suppresses its log.
EACCES and uid/secure/world-readable policy denial always produce ERR_PERM=2 with cannot access PATH: strerror(EACCES).
Other open/fstat errors produce ERR_NOTDEF=0 with cannot read PATH: strerror(errno), independently of Rust ErrorKind.
A real read failure uses the same ERR_NOTDEF full-path/error text and releases file/transfer state.
C sanitises the filename before constructing/logging ERR, retaining only isprint bytes in the fixed C locale. It drops controls, DEL and high bytes.
snprintf size500 includes the final zero; maximum ERR has499 message bytes, one zero and4 header bytes. Long error text is truncated before logging and transmitting.
One bounded formatted message is shared by wire and MS_TFTP|LOG_ERR. A logging consumer can extract code/message from the RuntimeEvent without reformatting; quiet suppresses only code1.
